user.title: Pricerunner
user.description: Pick one or more countries and paste links to the products you want to keep an eye on. You can also search for a product by name.

pick.title: Pick products
pick.description: Pick the products you want to follow.

init.title: Products
init.description: Remove products, or add new ones with a link or a search. You can also pick other countries.

alerts.title: Price alert
alerts.description: Enter the most you want to pay for a product. When the lowest price is at or below it, you get one message. Leave the field empty for no message.

hints.sites: Each country gets its own price in its own currency.
hints.foreign: Shops in other countries that sell to the country, e.g. Amazon.de on pricerunner.dk.
hints.links: Links to products on Pricerunner or Klarna, one per line. Copy the address from the product's page.
hints.search: Or search for a product by name.
hints.keep: Untick a product to stop following it.
hints.notify_users: The users' phones and browsers with push turned on. None picked means everyone.
hints.notify_service: E.g. notify.telegram. Used when "Another service" is chosen.

errors.cannot_connect: Could not fetch from Pricerunner. Try again in a moment.
errors.bad_link: That is not a link to a product on Pricerunner or Klarna. It must contain /pl/ or be a product id.
errors.other_site: The link is to a country you have not picked.
errors.not_found: Pricerunner does not have the product.
errors.bad_price: Enter the price as a number, e.g. 5999.
errors.bad_service: Enter the name of a notify service, e.g. notify.telegram.
